description: Install react-router-dom, create authentication pages (Login, Signup, ForgotPassword), auth layout with redirect logic, protected route wrapper, role-based routing, navigation component, and update App.tsx/main.tsx to use the router with auth guards. Add comprehensive tests.
steps: Install react-router-dom and @types/react-router-dom (if needed) via npm: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npm install react-router-dom

Create src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: email/password form that calls authStore.signIn(), shows loading state, displays error messages, has link to signup and forgot-password. Include data-testid attributes for testing.

Create src/pages/SignupPage.tsx: email/password form with role selection dropdown (DESIGNER/CONSULTANT - no ADMIN self-registration). Calls supabase.auth.signUp() with role in app_metadata. Shows loading/error states. Link back to login.
Create src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.tsx: email input form that calls supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(). Shows success message after submission. Link back to login.
Create src/pages/index.ts barrel export for all pages.

Create src/components/AuthLayout.tsx: a route layout component that checks auth state. If authenticated, redirects to the main app (/). Renders an <Outlet /> for nested auth routes (login, signup, forgot-password). Includes minimal branding/styling.

Create src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx: checks useAuthStore isAuthenticated and isLoading. While loading, shows a spinner/loading indicator. If not authenticated (and not loading), redirects to /login. Otherwise renders <Outlet />.

Create src/components/Navigation.tsx: role-aware navigation component (header or sidebar). Shows: app title, role indicator, mode toggle (Designer/Consultant buttons from current App.tsx header), BOM button, role-specific buttons (My Templates for DESIGNER, New Project for CONSULTANT), and Logout button that calls authStore.signOut().

Refactor src/App.tsx: Remove the inline header with mode buttons (move to Navigation). Keep canvas and panel logic. Integrate Navigation component at the top. App becomes the authenticated main view rendered inside ProtectedRoute.

Update src/main.tsx: Create BrowserRouter with route structure: (1) AuthLayout wrapping /login, /signup, /forgot-password routes, (2) ProtectedRoute wrapping / (index) route that renders App, (3) Catch-all redirect to /login for unknown paths.
Add a loading/splash screen state: when authStore.isLoading is true on initial mount, show a centered loading spinner before rendering routes.

Create src/pages/__tests__/LoginPage.test.tsx: Test rendering, form submission with valid credentials (mock signIn), error display on failed login, navigation links present, loading state during submission.

Create src/pages/__tests__/SignupPage.test.tsx: Test rendering, role selection options (DESIGNER/CONSULTANT only), form submission calling supabase.auth.signUp with correct metadata, error display, navigation back to login.

Create src/pages/__tests__/AuthRouting.test.tsx: Test that unauthenticated users are redirected to /login, authenticated users can access /, authenticated users accessing /login are redirected to /, role is properly available after auth.
Ensure all existing tests still pass by not breaking any existing component interfaces. The App component still renders all existing panels/overlays.
acceptance_criteria: react-router-dom is listed in package.json dependencies
LoginPage renders a form with email and password inputs and a submit button
SignupPage renders a form with email, password, and role selection (DESIGNER/CONSULTANT only)
ForgotPasswordPage renders an email input and submit button for password reset
Authenticated users see the main App with canvas and Navigation
Navigation shows role-specific buttons (My Templates for DESIGNER, New Project for CONSULTANT)
Logout button calls signOut and redirects to /login
Loading state shown during auth initialization (isLoading=true)
New tests pass covering login, signup, and routing logic
findings: Review fixes applied: (1) Moved subscribeToAuthChanges from App.tsx to AuthSubscription wrapper in main.tsx to resolve circular dependency where isLoading stayed true forever on cold start. (2) Fixed extractRole to check user_metadata as fallback after app_metadata so signup role is visible client-side. (3) Added minLength=6 on password inputs in LoginPage and SignupPage. (4) Added signUp and resetPassword actions to authStore; updated SignupPage and ForgotPasswordPage to use the store instead of calling supabase directly. (5) Added 11 Navigation tests covering logout, role-gated buttons, and mode toggle. All 320 tests pass (308 prior + 12 new). Build and typecheck clean.
